fact: The national AI strategy SNIA 2030 proposes adopting an AI law with risk classification and creating a national AI agency (ANIA) with a regulation and complaints mandate; neither is yet established.
title: Stratégie Nationale de l'Intelligence Artificielle à l'horizon 2030 (SNIA 2030)
publisher: République de Côte d'Ivoire, Ministère de la Transition Numérique et de la Digitalisation
